name: Kiran Syntex Limited
about: Kiran Syntex Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of polyester dyed yarns in India. It provides polyester mono, polyester filament, polyester air textured, polyester slub, and polyester space dyed yarns for use in textile and apparel industries. Kiran Syntex Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Surat, India.
